DE.source: SOG DE wrapper with the CA_*_DE seed-validation notebook controls

PSO.source: SOG PSO wrapper with the CA_*_PSO seed-validation notebook controls

UPSO.source: Unified PSO velocity blend with ring-local and global bests; legacy experimental controls

notes: The UPSO uses the velocity-level unified PSO update, not the SOG-labelled pyswarm PSO wrapper.
PSO and UPSO use the same pyswarm-compatible initialization, objective, bounds, seed list, and native stopping tolerances.
All selected algorithms use a shared cap of 15000 physical objective evaluations and a 300-second wall-clock limit per run.
If either limit is reached, the optimizer returns the best point evaluated so far.
A physical objective call already in progress is allowed to finish before the wall-clock limit stops it.
GIVP cache hits do not consume the physical-evaluation budget.
